  CRC64NVME after the host's FileStorage upload loaded the host's CRT copy would hit the NRE again. Libraries on the
  default CRC32 never touch the CRT and are safe.

  ❓ What I need from you — nothing.

  ⏭️ Next — If that ceiling matters, the FileStorage SDK moves to CRC32, and the host never loads the CRT integration.

  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
